new_question_exact.question: Under the explicitly attributed later FFG clarification of the original two-flare/select-one setup, when and how are chosen alien sheets revealed? Place the reveal relative to all players’ private choices, unused-sheet returns, and cosmic-deck and starting-hand preparation.

required_facts: Wait until all players have chosen their alien and returned the unused sheet.
Reveal all chosen alien sheets simultaneously.
Reveal before preparing the cosmic deck and dealing starting hands.
contextual_background: The original2008 setup does not state the reveal window. This operational step is an explicitly attributed later publisher clarification of the same selection procedure, not a retroactive erratum claim.
Original50/component scope and original flare-mixing/first-player procedures remain the target; other revised content is excluded.
